findings.highlight: though its purpose had been forgotten
findings.evidenceJa: その内容も、理由すらも定かではない決まり事
findings.governingReading: a rule whose contents are uncertain and whose very reason is unclear
findings.explanation: The English collapses two kinds of uncertainty into a definite claim that one remembered purpose was forgotten.

findings.highlight: to eliminate one of her competitors in this game
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争を汚す外敵を排除しに来た
findings.governingReading: to eliminate the outside enemy defiling the Holy Grail War
findings.explanation: Zouken is recast as an ordinary rival contestant, erasing Rin’s stated policing rationale and the idea that he is contaminating the war.

findings.highlight: the remorse towards someone who has endured it for over ten years
findings.evidenceJa: 十年以上も我慢し続けた、誰かに対する後悔だった
findings.governingReading: regret concerning someone, after Rin herself continued holding back for more than ten years
findings.explanation: The English assigns the decade of endurance to the unnamed person instead of Rin, changing the emotional history behind her regret.

findings.highlight: I should’ve came here earlier
findings.evidenceJa: どうせ破るのなら、もっと早くに押しかければ良かったのに
findings.governingReading: I should have come here earlier
findings.explanation: The English uses a nonstandard past form after “should have.”

findings.highlight: goes to the second floor
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は二階の隠し通路へ移動する
findings.governingReading: she moves to the hidden passage on the second floor
findings.explanation: The destination is reduced from the newly identified hidden passage to the floor in general, weakening the spatial continuity.

findings.highlight: urged
findings.evidenceJa: 後継ぎを鞭打ち
findings.governingReading: whip or scourge the heir
findings.explanation: The physical coercion inflicted through the worms is softened into encouragement.

findings.highlight: the pain of the engraved Magic Circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み
findings.governingReading: the pain of the engraved Magic Crest
findings.explanation: The English substitutes Magic Circuits for the inherited Magic Crest, conflating two distinct parts of Fate’s magical physiology.

findings.highlight: the Magic Association is accepting as a scholarship student
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術協会が特待生として迎え入れようとするほど
findings.governingReading: to such a degree that the Mage’s Association seeks to welcome her as a specially admitted student
findings.explanation: A prospective institutional offer is reported as an accomplished acceptance, and the special-admission status is narrowed to a scholarship.

findings.highlight: Rin can create a spell that the successor of the Matou family has been unable to create even after ten years
findings.evidenceJa: 十年かけてまだ習得できない魔術を、凛ならば半年で書き換える事ができる
findings.governingReading: Rin could rewrite in six months the magecraft the Matou heir has still not mastered after ten years
findings.explanation: The English changes revising an existing inherited system into independently creating a spell and changes failure to master it into failure to create it.

findings.highlight: this method of learning is madness
findings.evidenceJa: その愚鈍な学習方法
findings.governingReading: that slow, stupid method of instruction
findings.explanation: A criticism of the method’s crude inefficiency becomes a categorical judgment of insanity.

findings.highlight: she can only hesitate
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は言葉を飲むしかない
findings.governingReading: she can only swallow her words
findings.explanation: Rin’s inability to claim she could endure the torture is weakened into momentary hesitation.

findings.highlight: the threatening attitude she’s taking
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂凛という少女が放つ殺意
findings.governingReading: the murderous intent emanating from the girl Tohsaka Rin
findings.explanation: Shinji’s fear of Rin’s literal readiness to kill him is softened into fear of hostile demeanor.

findings.highlight: What a pack of morons
findings.evidenceJa: 頭悪いよね
findings.governingReading: You’re stupid, aren’t you
findings.explanation: Shinji’s direct singular taunt at Rin becomes an unexplained plural insult, muddying its target.

findings.highlight: He was willing to tell her anything she wanted to know about the old man
findings.evidenceJa: これが臓硯に関する事ならば、彼は即座に漏らしていただろう
findings.governingReading: if this concerned Zouken, he would have spilled it immediately
findings.explanation: A counterfactual diagnostic of what Shinji is withholding becomes a broad assertion that he was willing to answer anything about Zouken.

findings.highlight: Telling her why he became a Master is like asking for death
findings.evidenceJa: マスターになった理由を明かす事は死に等しい
findings.governingReading: revealing why he became a Master is equivalent to death for him
findings.explanation: The English turns intolerable exposure of his shame into an act likely to provoke literal killing.

findings.highlight: wanted proof
findings.evidenceJa: 欲しくもない証を欲しがっただけ
findings.governingReading: merely wanted proof he did not even truly want
findings.explanation: The contradiction in Shinji’s status hunger—coveting a token he does not intrinsically desire—is erased.

findings.highlight: nor is he suited to be a Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとして相応しくない雑種ではないか
findings.governingReading: is he not an unworthy mongrel, unfit to be a Master
findings.explanation: The animalizing slur central to Shinji’s class and lineage contempt disappears.

findings.highlight: just a lucky bastard that made a contract with Saber
findings.evidenceJa: ただ運良くセイバーと契約できただけの野良犬
findings.governingReading: a stray dog who merely happened to contract with Saber by luck
findings.explanation: The repeated animal and pedigree image driving Shinji’s contempt is replaced by a generic insult.

findings.highlight: The girl sighs and shrugs her shoulders
findings.evidenceJa: その、偏執しきった視線
findings.governingReading: before that thoroughly obsessive stare, Tohsaka Rin heaves a sigh
findings.explanation: Shinji’s obsessive gaze—the immediate reason for Rin’s response—is omitted.

findings.highlight: She turns her back on him
findings.evidenceJa: 瞳を苛立たせたまま
findings.governingReading: with irritation still in her eyes, she turns her back on him
findings.explanation: Rin’s continuing anger at the moment she dismisses Shinji disappears.

findings.highlight: No matter how much you consider yourself to be a Master
findings.evidenceJa: 自分をマスターだと言い張っても
findings.governingReading: no matter how insistently you claim to be a Master
findings.explanation: Shinji’s stubborn verbal insistence is softened into private self-conception.

findings.highlight: keeps laughing
findings.evidenceJa: ひきつった顔で笑い続ける
findings.governingReading: keeps laughing with a strained or contorted face
findings.explanation: The facial sign of Shinji’s psychological collapse is omitted.

findings.highlight: His laughter
findings.evidenceJa: 空っぽの哄笑
findings.governingReading: empty, booming laughter
findings.explanation: The concluding echo of Rin’s “empty inside” diagnosis disappears from Shinji’s laughter.
